positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed MEF applications and components. Debugged and modified software components.
• Maintained existing applications and designed and delivered new applications.
• Used: Visual Studio, VB.Net, VB6 (COM, ActiveX server), Crystal Report, MSSQL, MEF

positions.title: Consultant/Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed applications and components to Integrate/Handle/Manage Coins & Banknotes counting machines, and DVRs to the Core System.
• Worked closely with clients (in Spain, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, and Argentina) to establish problem specifications and system designs.
• Used: Visual Studio, VB.Net, C#, PL/SQL, RS232, TCP/IP.

positions.title: Software Developer (Lead)
positions.description:
• Designed and developed Access Control Systems (Client-Server applications and components) using HID VertX devices.
• Modified existing software to correct errors, adapt to new hardware and improve performance.
• Worked closely with clients (On site) to establish problem specifications and solve problems.
• Used: Visual Studio, C#, VB.Net, VB6, MySQL, EPPLUS.

positions.title: Scientific Programmer
positions.description:
• Modified existing software to correct errors, adapt to new hardware and improve performance.
• Designed new product elements to manage Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) based equipment.
• Collaborated with Electronics engineers, Chemistry and Physics Ph.Ds. to create company’s commercial application and internal Research and Development tools.
• Worked on Research & Development projects. Worked closely with clients (on site and remotely).
• Integration of Coriolis Flowmeter, Temperature and Pressure sensors/devices, pumps, valves, scales, 
 and company’s Flowmeter to simulate Oil extraction field process.
• Used: Visual Studio, SharpDevelop, C#, C++ (debugging some Math Specific Libraries), RS485, RS232, USB, Parallel port, TCP/IP, UDP, WinForm, WPF, Entity Framework, MEF, Multi-Thread, EPPLUS, iTextSharp, IT related task.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Modified existing software to correct errors, adapt to new hardware and improve performance.
• Designed and Developed applications for Electrophysiology and Hemodynamics studies.
• Worked closely with Electronic engineers and related technical areas.
• Worked and successfully developed the “SMVA” system. It manages and coordinate several devices like (Fluke testers, Protek power supply, Relay towers, wave simulators, etc…) to pass quality protocols to the electronic boards of company’s medical equipment.
• Used: Visual Studio, C#, VB.Net, VB6, MS Access, MSSQL, TCP/IP, RS232, Multi-Thread, Concurrent Programming, Windows Service, GDI+.
